pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients. The patches exhibit significant size variation, with larger, elongated geometries on the neck and shoulder transitioning to smaller, more fragmented and rounded patches on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial network forming a complex topological web with frequent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. The corridors exhibit relatively uniform pixel thickness across the flank, maintaining high continuity with no visible terminal breaks.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged 1D contour along the dorsal neck. The mane silhouette presents a serrated edge against the background, extending from the upper neck through the shoulder ridge.
